notes.title: Seven years later, superb racing game blows up on Steam thanks to sale
notes.notes:
Older games getting a new lease on life is always great to see, and rally racer WRC 7 is no exception. There are so many games on Steam that it's incredibly easy for a release to be forgotten, but as soon as players have a reason to come back, be it a sale, update, or just some miraculous word of mouth, older games can be back in the forefront.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: eSports WRC: The new season starts now!
notes.notes:
eSports WRC is back for a third season!

This competition is open to all players of WRC 7, the official game of the FIA World Rally Championship (WRC). 
During this first round, players will face the legendary Rallye Monte-Carlo at the same time that the real pilots.

https://youtu.be/DruZOjxnyi0

This year, a brand new team championship has been created! Starting from Rally Sweden on February 15th, the best drivers will score points for their crew and try to win the first eSports WRC team championship title.

Who will challenge Nexl, the undisputed champion of 2017? It could be you! So get ready to face the challenging icy stages of the iconic Monte Carlo Rally on January 25th.

Details and information on http://www.esportswrc.com/
For any questions regarding the team championship: teams@esportswrc.com

notes.title: WRC 7 Patch 1.4 is now live!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30504234/caade3e4cb7232b672c637e88751327431b226a6.png[/img]

We’ve updated WRC 7 to version 1.4.

The patch tackles two main points:
	1. The correction of multiple discrepancies relating to the representation of teams, drivers and their cars.
	2. Improvements to the level design on certain tracks that previously allowed players to gain an unfair advantage by exploiting the track geometry. These changes were particularly important to us in order guarantee fair competition in the upcoming eSports WRC season.

We thank you again for your continued feedback and support.

You can find the full changelog below.

[b]Licence corrections:[/b]
	- Fixed nationalities which were wrongly displayed:
			o Sebastien Marshall in GB
			o Sergei Larens in Estonian
	- Fixed teams which were wrongly displayed:
			o F.W.R.T for Lorenzo Bertelli
			o OneBet Jipocar World Rally Team for Martin Prokop
			o Accents for Dennis Rådström
			o Team: ADAC Sachsen e.V.
	- Fixed car names which were wrongly displayed:
			o Quentin Giordano : Peugeot 208 T16
			o Ford Fiesta RS WRC becomes Ford Fiesta WRC
			o BMW-Mini John Cooper Works

[b]Improvements to level design have been carried out on the following stages:[/b]
	- Monte-Carlo - Special Stage - Agnieres en devoluy
	- Sardegna - Special Stage - Lerno 
	- Portugal - Special Stage - Fafe 
	- Deutschland - Super Special Stage - Panzerplate
	- Australia - Super Special Stage - Coffs
	- Poland - Super Special Stage - Mikolajki Arena

[b]Miscellaneous [/b]
An issue with Nvidia Ansel technology in the game has been fixed.

notes.title: eSports WRC season #3 starting soon!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30504234/8982285d43b2c9502ff1f617c15cacf313938cad.png[/img]

[b]eSport WRC 2018 World Championship[/b]

The third annual eSports WRC Season is almost upon us. From the 25th of January, the WRC 7 players will compete to become the best driver in the world. 

This year will see a similar format to last year – the official WRC rallies mirrored in the game – but this time in quicker succession. The regular season will run until the end of July and culminate during the Rally Finland, followed by the Grand Final later in the year. Check out the calendar below! 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30504234/7715749d143dcc1f6bad82af1ed68821896271ae.png[/img]

Like last year, every rally will run from Thursday to Sunday and drivers will have 5 attempts to record their best time. Each round will usually contain of a Super Special Stage (or a Special stage in the case of Rally Wales GB, Rally Monte Carlo and Tour de Corse) and one of the new Epic Stages. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30504234/098305d0b7f2eff61a01373282d017f4cab18193.png[/img]

Placing among the top 50 for each Rally will earn players championship points and the players who accrue the most points over the course of the season will earn a spot in the Grand Final. Unlike last year, in 2018 every single championship round counts!

[b]eSports WRC 2018 Team Championship[/b]

In addition to the regular Championship, this year will see the inaugural eSports WRC Team Championship. 

Pre-selected teams of up to 5 players will compete to be crowned the best WRC eSports Team in the world. The field of team will mainly consist of teams recognized in the eSports racing scene and will be revealed before the first round.

Each round, the championship points earned by the three best performing team members will be added to the team score. The team with the most championship points at the end of the regular season will be crowned champion! 


Will TX3_Nexl repeat is impressive and dominating performance of 2017? Who will challenge the undisputed champion? Will we see familiar faces or completely new challengers? And which team will ascend and becom the first eSport WRC Team Champion?

This year is shaping up to be off to an exciting start!

We can’t wait for the competition to kick off and wish all drivers a most successful 2018 season!

notes.title: Patch 1.2 is live
notes.notes:
The latest patch addresses performance issues, improving peripheral detection, FFB and addressing several bugs. 

You can find the patch notes below.

(The new version number is 1.2.)

Patch notes:
- Improved detection of peripherals
- Enhanced Force Feedback on steering wheels and added manual settings to the options menu
- Improved performance
- Implemented the option toggle dynamic field of view and motion blur on and off
- Improved vsync on high end machines
- Fix a bug that caused headlights on a WV Polo to always be on
- Fixed an issue that could cause an infinite loop when players were disconnected from multiplayer
- Fixed a crash bug during multiplayer lobby creation
